tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (21.0:1).

tokens.name: color-yellow
tokens.usage: Primary brand, headers, CTAs. Used as text on `.footer-section h4`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-magenta
tokens.usage: Memphis playfulness, highlights. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: color-green
tokens.usage: Success states, decorative. Used as background on `body`; text on `.footer-link:hover`; border on `.footer-link:hover`. 1.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-blue
tokens.usage: Links, interactive states. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: color-black
tokens.usage: Borders, shadows, typography. Used as text on `body`, `.logo`, `.nav-link`; shadow/glow on `.logo`, `.logo:hover`, `.logo:active`. 21.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Backgrounds, negative space. Used as text on `.nav-link.active`, `.stat-card:nth-child(2)`, `.stat-card:nth-child(4)`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: shadow-color
tokens.usage: Borders, shadows, typography. Used as shadow/glow on `.header`, `.stat-card:hover`, `.feature-card:hover`.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings, set in uppercase — as `h2.sr-only` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles, set in uppercase — as `h3.card-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Minor headings, set in uppercase — as `h4` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `li` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, set in uppercase — as `a.card-button` on the reference page.
